web.title: Japananese octogenarian becomes oldest person to sail solo across Pacific
web.description:
Japanese yachtsman Kenichi Horie waves from his yacht after arriving at Shin Nishinomiya Yacht Harbor in Nishinomiya, Hyogo prefecture on June 4, 2022. - Horie, 83, arrived in Japan early on June 4 after a solo, non-stop trip across the Pacific, becoming the oldest person ever to achieve the feat.

# Japananese octogenarian becomes oldest person to sail solo across Pacific
TOKYO (AP) — An 83-year-old Japanese adventurer returned home Saturday after successfully completing his solo, nonstop voyage across the Pacific, becoming the oldest person to reach the milestone.

In this picture taken on January 24, 2022, Japanese sailor and adventurer Kenichi Horie addresses the media in front of his yacht before leaving for the United States, in Nishinomiya of Hyogo Prefecture. - 83-year-old yachtsman Horie arrived in Japan early on June 4, 2022, after a solo, non-stop trip across the Pacific, becoming the oldest person ever to achieve the feat. - Japan OUT (Photo by JIJI PRESS / AFP) / Japan OUT (Photo by STR/JIJI PRESS/AFP via Getty Images)
